description: Source code for the EclipseWriter class, which generates Eclipse CDT project settings XML files based on build targets, include directories, and defines.

classes.name: EclipseWriter
classes.description: A class responsible for generating Eclipse CDT project configuration files based on build targets.

methods.name: EscapeForXML
methods.description: Escapes special characters in a string for safe inclusion in XML content.

methods.name: RunAndWriteFile
methods.description: Static method to create and write the Eclipse CDT settings XML file.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the process of gathering include directories, defines, and writing the settings file.

methods.name: GetAllIncludeDirs
methods.description: Collects all include directories from build targets that use the default toolchain.

methods.name: GetAllDefines
methods.description: Collects all macro definitions from build targets that use the default toolchain.

methods.name: UsesDefaultToolchain
methods.description: Checks if a target uses the default toolchain.

methods.name: WriteCDTSettings
methods.description: Writes the collected include directories and defines into an Eclipse CDT project settings XML.
